description.text: Program Description Managementengineering is a new interdisciplinary subject of engineering technology and management. This major cultivates compound senior management talents who have basic knowledge of management, economics and civil engineering technology, and master theories, methods and methods of modern management science. Main practical teaching links: including cognition practice, production practice, course design, computer application and computer practice, graduation practice, graduation thesis (design), etc., generally arranged for 30 weeks. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Management Engineering at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
